findings.text: Launcher treats gh auth status success as sufficient; no scope/account repair when private repository access fails.
Fresh GitHub device-flow has not been tested with a credential-free profile.
No fresh RDC Device ready/Online/handshake SHA round-trip for V6.
Self-test does not verify that all RDC handshake fields are parsed and validated together, including GUID and negative Offline case.
Node, Git and GitHub CLI are installed via floating LTS/latest package IDs rather than exact versions.
Vercel CLI/login is inherited from V5; necessity remains unconfirmed.
Automatic browser-opening flows require review under Metacanon §24; prefer terminal URL/code and explicit user authorization.
winget is required when GitHub CLI is absent; no fallback path is validated.

next_incident.assessment: A separate start_process record from another working directory; not invoked by V6.

acceptance_gate: Resolve GitHub private access recovery, test fresh GitHub authorization and fresh RDC handshake; close or explicitly accept remaining dependency/GUI findings.
